compiled_state.title: [T6][UPDATE] Register compliance-verifier hook + add feature flag
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Wire pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh into the hook infrastructure.

## .pre-commit-config.yaml
Add new entry using established wrapper pattern:
  - id: compliance-verifier
    name: Compliance verifier
    entry: ./plugins/dso/scripts/pre-commit-wrapper.sh compliance-verifier 30 "./plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh"
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true
    stages: [pre-commit]

## dso-config.conf
Add default: hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled=false

## Note
The .pre-commit-config.yaml entry and the feature-flag default are coupled — both must land in the same commit. The pre-commit shim at the git hook path is populated by 'pre-commit install' (already invoked by reinstall-hooks.sh); adding the .yaml entry makes it discoverable.

UPDATE. Depends on T5.
